sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:271

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:271:1
items.html: And just as there are ascents in holiness etc. so too in the shells: Meaning, at the time that Assiya ascends to Yetzira, the Atik of Assiya of the shell is lost, and there remains only the AA of the shell, as in Yetzira. And when Yetzira ascends to Beria, there remain in them only AVI, and when Beria ascends to Atzilut, AVI too are concealed from them, and there remain only the ZON of the shells.
